bio: Got beaten up by CapFck12 in prison. Was close to THF 46 around 2010 and attempted to join them.
Got along well with Lil Varney of Lamron. Killed in 2019 at a party in Jaro City.
Was friends with D-Thang of the 600.
Urinated on Karl of THF 46's grave in 2011. Allegedly hit someone with his car during a shootout.
Beat up RondoNumba9 of the 600 in prison. Was best friends with Polo of the same set.
Participated in killing L'A Capone of the 600. Snitched on Lil Mick in prison to halve his own sentence.
Long-standing OG.
Named Fatz World after his death, a tribute in his honor.
Racketed Chief Keef with THF Rome. Was in a relationship with THF Raheem's mother and considered him his son.
In prison, took an inmate hostage threatening to stab a guard. Threw urine and feces on guards. Beat an inmate who reported him for using their belongings.
Was very close to Raheem of the same set.
Shot 051 Ario and 051 Melly in 2015, grazing their heads. They survived and killed him in retaliation. Did not accept THF Bayzoo as his stepfather. Very close to Lil T of the same set.
Was wanted by the FBI.
Incarcerated for a murder he did not commit.
Racketed GBE Capo with THF Twilla.
Racketed Tay600 with THF Gino. Killed in 2017 less than an hour after being released from prison.
Racketed Tadoe of Front$treet with THF Twin.
Racketed TYMB Money Man with Uly, Tay600 with Bob-O, and Rudeboi of the NLMB.
True killer of Goon of TouchMoney, for whose murder B.A. is incarcerated.
Racketed Chief Keef with Bayzoo. Shot King Louie of MuBu in the head.
Known as Twilla The Killer or TTK. Racketed GBE Capo with Big Dave.
Became known for his diss track 'Death of 150'. Killed in 2017 at 9am outside his house getting into his car, shot 15 times in the face.
Chased and hunted Lil Herb of the NLMB.
Became stepfather to the son of J-Money of O'Block.
Racketed GBE Capo.
From Terror Dome and continues to represent them.
Snitched on his own cousin in a murder.
Killed in retaliation for Lil Jojo.
